blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — The Dinagyang Festival’s main tribes competition will return to Iloilo City’s historic downtown area in January 2027, with organizers proposing five judging areas and a redesigned lighted street parade. The Iloilo Festivals Foundation Inc. (IFFI) presented its initial plans during a consultative meeting with festival stakeholders on Friday, outlining proposed routes, schedules, staging areas and crowd-management measures. For 2027, organizers are adopting a theme of “homecoming and cultural reclamation,” with the competing tribes returning to historical performance routes. The proposed judging areas are the Iloilo Freedom Grandstand, Iloilo Provincial Capitol, Quezon-Ledesma area, Mabini-de Leon and Iznart Street. READ: […]...
